notes.title: ✨ Interstellar Sentinel 2 – Surge & Balance Update
notes.notes:
Interstellar Sentinel 2 – v0.5.0 Build Update Notes

[previewyoutube="hE2nLz0P7CI;full"][/previewyoutube]Gameplay & Balance
Increased player starting lives to 30 (for Easy difficulty testing, reduces continue screen churn).

Shield power-up: increased attraction radius to make it easier to grab under duress.

Riot Shield Mechs:

Nerfed overall health.

Fixed bug where shield could be left behind if the mech was killed under certain circumstances.

Large Robonoid Minigunner: added a little more time between bullet waves.

Materializer Tanks: increased HP.

Materializer Cannon: added more cannon shot strings and increased shot speed.

Adjusted Highness & Royale Highness scores.

Astral Projection:

Buffed melee damage.

Adjusted damage curves and tick rate for consistency.

Rapid Shot: increased starting spread size and spread starting streams to 3, added wider spread shot streams on upgrades, adjusted damage curves for consistency.

Overcharge Swords:

Added bullet impact sparks.
[hr][/hr]Enemies & Bosses
Large Robonoids:

Fixed missing teleportation VFX.

First enemy surge: bring forward more, update teleport VFX/timing.

DTCD Boss:

Intro: cut music, add screen shake during boss construction.

Robo Kensis building section: add hologram warnings for reverse/top/bottom buildings.

Head phase 2: make a bigger moment with large outward particle explosion that then reverses into head reconstruction.

Fixed laser tower section stuck bug.

Laser Towers:

From top: added a warning indicator before appearing.

Laser tower field: base parts are now the criteria for triggering the enemy surge condition.

Space Ripper Enemy Surge Wave: (4 large Robonoids): add teleportation and/or back warning sign, offset entrance further back.

Adjusted health for both level 1 bosses
[hr][/hr]Visual & Effects
Fixed laser grids / Robonoid vertical waves spawning too early.

Sentinel Tower: adjusted Z-sorting of H-building for enemy surge Materializer Tank.

Added boss damage chain combo maintainer.

Added chain combo maintainer for bosses in general.

DTCD Boss destruction: added music transition + explosion SFX for head/body destruction.

Lens flare polish pass in the city.

City build: adjusted top parallax speed (slowed).
[hr][/hr]UI & Text
Fixed tutorial confirmation text: changed from “reverse shot” to Back Shot (also updated frontend button mapping).

Backward shot: fixed text confirmation.

Double-check Loki rank condition (validation pending).

Secret item: Moved the spawn to the lower third of the screen, moved the sparkle and AOE ring above the clouds.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Free 0.3.0 Demo Update - Secret Caravan Challenge Added
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to all the Steam Next Fest players for checking out our game! Based on community playtesting, we've fixed a number of bugs, added a bit more polish, and added a secret bonus level for people chasing those high scores. 



We're watching and listening, so don't hesitate to keep sharing your feedback and playtest videos. It's super fun to see the new strategies emerge.
